fidelity_to_mechanism.description: Whether the model faithfully recapitulates the disease mechanism.
fidelity_to_mechanism.title: Fidelity To Mechanism

inheritance_match.description: Whether the inheritance pattern matches the human MDE.
inheritance_match.title: Inheritance Match

local_sequence_similarity_high.description: Whether local sequence similarity around the VBC is high (for some variant types).
local_sequence_similarity_high.title: Local Sequence Similarity High

ortholog_established.description: Whether the animal gene is an established ortholog of the human gene.
ortholog_established.title: Ortholog Established

phenotype_replication.description: How well the model replicates the human phenotype.

ExonDuplicationOutcome.description: Which of the six scored duplication/gain branches (or whole-gene NA) applies (SM 14).
ExonDuplicationOutcome.title: ExonDuplicationOutcome

ExonDuplicationPredictiveEvidence.description:
The duplication/gain predictive (PRD) step of a branch (SM 14).

Tandem NMD starts at +6.0; gain NMD at +4.0; the tandem/gain no-NMD branches derive
initial points from the fraction of ORF duplicated (upper orange) or protein disrupted
(violet) or the criticality of the duplicated amino acids; the terminal-exon branches
award no initial points (SM 18 not applicable). Positive points are reduced by the
SM 18 matrix on the branches that award them.

adjusted_points.description: Coded PRD points after the SM 18 adjustment.
adjusted_points.title: Adjusted Points

basis.description: Predictive basis (e.g. tandem NMD; % ORF duplicated; critical domain).
basis.title: Basis

duplicated_domain_critical.description: Duplicated amino acids alter a proven critical disease-relevant domain.
duplicated_domain_critical.title: Duplicated Domain Critical

includes_terminal_exon_or_utr.description: Duplication includes the first exon, last exon, or either UTR.
includes_terminal_exon_or_utr.title: Includes Terminal Exon Or Utr

initial_points.description: Initial PRD points before the SM 18 adjustment.
initial_points.title: Initial Points

molecularly_tandem.description: VBC molecularly proven tandem (vs an unproven copy-number gain).
molecularly_tandem.title: Molecularly Tandem

nmd_predicted.description: Introduced PTC >50 bp upstream of the last exon-intron boundary predicts NMD.
nmd_predicted.title: Nmd Predicted

orf_fraction_duplicated.description: Fraction of ORF duplicated / protein disrupted (the >50%..<10% table).
orf_fraction_duplicated.title: Orf Fraction Duplicated

ExonDuplicationPredictiveEvidence.title: ExonDuplicationPredictiveEvidence

ExonRelevance.description:
Clinical relevance of the exon containing (or affected by) the VBC across
disease-relevant transcripts (SM 18): ALL (×1.0), MOST (×0.5), FEW (×0).
ExonRelevance.title: ExonRelevance

FunctionalAssayEvidence.description:
SM 20 functional-assay inputs for a PFD assessment.

Captured; the scoring (OddsPath→points via Tables 1/2 for protein assays;
Table 3's 0.0 to +4.0 for animal models; the combination rules) is
documented, not computed.

disease_mechanism.description: The MDE's molecular mechanism the assays are evaluated against.

FunctionalAssayEvidence.title: FunctionalAssayEvidence

GenccMechanism.description:
GenCC level to which loss-of-function is established as the MDE's disease
mechanism (SM 18). Full strength at ESTABLISHED, halved at LIKELY, quartered
at SUSPECTED, zeroed at UNCERTAIN. Usable only for MDEs at Moderate+
gene-disease validity (``WorkflowParameters.gene_disease_validity``);
Limited-or-below is treated as UNCERTAIN.
GenccMechanism.title: GenccMechanism

InformativeVariant.description:
A single distinct variant (not the VBC) informative for the VBC's
classification. Only distinct variants count; observation counts are
irrelevant (SM 19).

circularity_checked.description: Whether the analyst confirmed the VBC was not used as evidence for this variant's classification (circularity avoided).
circularity_checked.title: Circularity Checked

classification.description: The informative variant's own pathogenicity classification.

distinct_evidence_from_vbc.description: Whether it reached its classification via different evidence codes/weights than the VBC — required for it to count (SM 19).
distinct_evidence_from_vbc.title: Distinct Evidence From Vbc

similarity_basis.description: Why it is informative for the VBC (position/exon/effect/deletion).

star_rating.description: ClinVar review star rating, for external classifications (usable only at 3-4 stars with circularity avoided).
star_rating.title: Star Rating

InformativeVariant.title: InformativeVariant

InformativeVariantsEvidence.description:
SM 19 informative-variants inputs for a PFD assessment.

Captured; the scoring (+2.0 first distinct P / +1.0 each additional, cap
±8; mirror negatives for B/LB) is documented, not computed.

variants.description: 0..many distinct informative variants (observation counts do not matter).
variants.title: Variants

InformativeVariantsEvidence.title: InformativeVariantsEvidence

ManeStatus.description: MANE membership of the assessed transcript, anchoring exon relevance.
ManeStatus.title: ManeStatus

MechanismExonRelevanceEvidence.description:
SM 18 mechanism × exon-relevance inputs for a PFD assessment.

Permissive superset (every field optional). Captured; the multiplier
(mechanism fraction × exon-relevance fraction, applied to positive PRD
points, not compounded) is documented, not computed.

exon_has_established_pathogenic.description: SM 18 override: the exon contains expert/established pathogenic variants, so no exon-relevance reduction is applied.
exon_has_established_pathogenic.title: Exon Has Established Pathogenic

exon_known_irrelevant.description: SM 18 override: the exon is known to be clinically irrelevant (e.g. TRDN exons 9-41), forcing exon relevance to zero.
exon_known_irrelevant.title: Exon Known Irrelevant

exon_relevance.description: Clinical relevance of the VBC's exon across transcripts (All/Most/Few).

gencc_mechanism.description: GenCC level LoF is established as the disease mechanism; gated on Moderate+ gene-disease validity (see GenccMechanism).

mane_status.description: MANE membership of the assessed transcript.

MechanismExonRelevanceEvidence.title: MechanismExonRelevanceEvidence

MolecularMechanism.description:
The MDE's molecular mechanism of disease that an assay must faithfully
recapitulate to count (SM 20).
MolecularMechanism.title: MolecularMechanism

PfdParentCode.description: The PFD parent evidence code a variant-type workflow resolves to (SM 1).
PfdParentCode.title: PfdParentCode

PhenotypeReplication.description: How well the animal model replicates the human phenotype (SM 20, Table 3).
PhenotypeReplication.title: PhenotypeReplication

ProteinFunctionalAssay.description:
A protein/cellular functional assay, OddsPath-calibrated (SM 20).

Requires both pathogenic and benign variant controls; small experiments with
no false positives/negatives use lookup Tables 1/2 (documented, not computed).

benign_control_count.description: Number of benign controls in the calibration set.
benign_control_count.title: Benign Control Count

fidelity_to_mechanism.description: Whether the assay faithfully recapitulates the disease mechanism.
fidelity_to_mechanism.title: Fidelity To Mechanism

has_benign_controls.description: Whether known benign variant controls were used.
has_benign_controls.title: Has Benign Controls

has_false_positives_or_negatives.description: Whether the experiment had false positives/negatives (which route calibration to expert math, beyond the lookup tables).
has_false_positives_or_negatives.title: Has False Positives Or Negatives

has_pathogenic_controls.description: Whether known pathogenic variant controls were used.
has_pathogenic_controls.title: Has Pathogenic Controls

odds_path.description: OddsPath / likelihood ratio from the calibrated truth set.
odds_path.title: Odds Path

pathogenic_control_count.description: Number of pathogenic controls in the calibration set.
pathogenic_control_count.title: Pathogenic Control Count

ProteinFunctionalAssay.title: ProteinFunctionalAssay

SimilarityBasis.description: Why a variant is informative for the VBC (SM 19) — variant-type dependent.
SimilarityBasis.title: SimilarityBasis

VariantClassification.description:
A variant's pathogenicity classification. Introduced for informative
variants (SM 19), whose scoring keys on P/LP vs B/LB. Not (yet) applied to
the placeholder ``classification`` strings on other Case sub-models.
VariantClassification.title: VariantClassification

description:
A single/multi-exon duplication/gain (NUL_/CDS_) assessment (SM 14).

One entity for all six scored branches plus the whole-gene NA outcome, parameterized by
``prediction_outcome``; reuses the SM 18/19/20 submodules and the shared ``PfdParentCode``
(NUL/CDS). Permissive superset; the per-branch pipeline and its caps are documented, not
computed. ``functional`` is left unset on the gain paths (blue/violet/green), where SM 14
codes functional data as NA.

functional.description: SM 20 functional-assay evidence (FXN); NA on the gain paths.

parent_code.description: The resolved parent code (NUL or CDS per branch).

parent_total.description: Capped parent-code total for this branch.
parent_total.title: Parent Total

prd_fxn_combined.description: Held PRD + FXN combined value (no distinct code).
prd_fxn_combined.title: Prd Fxn Combined

prediction_outcome.description: Which of the six scored branches (or whole-gene NA) applies.

title: ExonDuplicationAssessment
